primary_sources.citation: Livshyts--Paouris--Pivovarov, On sharp bounds for marginal densities of product measures, Israel J. Math. 216 (2016), Theorem 1.1, arXiv:1507.07949
primary_sources.scope_used: genuine cap-one product J-bank; two-dimensional orthogonal marginal density <=2

partner_result_applied.stress_family: Q_(m,eta)=2 X0 G+2 eta G V+(b0 C+rho B)^2, b0=sqrt(63)/8, rho=1/8, spectrum {-sqrt(1+eta^2),1,sqrt(1+eta^2)}

new_result.general_statement: For disjoint original source blocks X0,J,K, if X0 has density cap <=1, (G,C) is a 2D orthogonal projection of the cap-one J product law, (B,V) are arbitrary K-bank statistics, and Q=2G X0+2 eta G V+(b C+rho B)^2 with b!=0, then ||p_Q||inf <=3*4^(2/3)|b|^(-2/3).
new_result.proof_currency: condition B only; conditional T=X0+eta V is convolution of f_X0 with a probability law and hence cap <=1; T is genuinely independent of J pair; translate C; apply completed scalar/dependent-pair receiver; average conditional laws

unresolved_implication: the bare three-large-eigenvalue hypothesis does not force the singleton-smoother plus orthogonal-J-pair plus conditionable-K-bank source decomposition
